scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules dist client/node_modules client/dist server/node_modules server/dist
scripts.check: npm run check:agent-guidance && npm run agent:skills && npm run check:generate && npm run check:typecheck && npm run check:test && npm run check:build && npm run check:ui && npm run check:format && npm run check:generated
scripts.check:generate: npm run api && npm run build:server
scripts.build: npm run api && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.deploy: npm run build && bkper app sync && bkper app deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && bkper app sync && bkper app deploy --preview
